Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Boris Nemtsov was born in Gorky (now Nizhny Novgorod) based on a snippet of text visible in the viewport of the Wikipedia page. The visible text explicitly states he was "raised in Gorky," not born there. The birthplace information ("Born October 9, 1959, in Sochi...") is located in the infobox, which was not visible in the viewport (only 4% of the page was shown). The Planner failed to scroll down or recognize that the visible text referred to his upbringing rather than his birth, leading to a false conclusion that contradicted the correct answer (Sochi) found in earlier search results and the actual Wikipedia content.
